profile.name: Priya Shah
profile.summary: Analytical, problem-solving supply chain analyst with 7 years in food retail.

descriptions: Rebuilt the weekly demand forecasting model for 3,000 SKUs in Excel and Python, combining promotional calendars, seasonality and store-level sales history, and presented the results in the monthly S&OP meeting, which cut forecast error from 32% to 21% within two quarters
Set safety stock and reorder points for 2 distribution centres, reducing stockouts by 18% while lowering inventory by 9%
Tracked 40 suppliers and two 3PL partners against service-level KPIs in a monthly scorecard
Built Power BI dashboards used daily by 25 operations managers
Wrote SQL queries against the SAP data warehouse to automate 6 weekly inventory reports
Presented findings to the operations director and site leads
Excel (Power Query, pivot tables), SQL, Python, Power BI, SAP
